title: Denver Charter Fishing
specs: Premium 2026 Bentley Legacy 220 Navigator 22 foot pontoon boat with quad lounge layout
Fishing technology includes Garmin Live Scope fish finder and top of the line trolling motor
Cherry Creek Reservoir offers Denver skyline and mountain views, 20 minutes from downtown
Chatfield Reservoir offers mountain backdrop and exceptional fishing
Valid Colorado fishing license required for every guest planning to fish
Fishing licenses must be purchased before the trip
includes: All gear, bait, fuel, and guide service included
Lunch included on six and eight hour trips
blurb: Guests board a premium pontoon boat for fishing or boating trips on Cherry Creek or Chatfield Reservoirs. Trips include all gear, bait, fuel, and guide service. Fishing licenses are required for anglers and must be purchased separately.
extraNote: Flat group rates for up to 11 guests, no per person charges, no hidden fees · Booking processing fee and gratuity for guide are additional · Designated reservoir access point at Cherry Creek or Chatfield Reservoir
